Chapter 1 — The Glasshouse
Pages: 12
The glasshouse on the point burned all night the winter my mother left, and by morning the beach was strewn with saltglass.

Chapter 2 — Tidewrack
Pages: 11
Aldous poled the ferry through the tidewrack at slack water, counting the drowned pilings as he passed.

notes.title: Driftwood Workshop — Chapter 2 critique
notes.content: Read-through of Chapter 2, Tidewrack. Fixes to make before next session: move the letter scene to the end of the chapter; rename the ferryman Aldous to Bren; trim the gull descriptions on the beach walk.
